name: ashta-eight-backend
description: Ashta Eight R1 REST API — Node/Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL (RLS)

scripts.db:grants: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; psql "${DATABASE_URL%%\?*}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v app_role="$APP_ROLE" -v service_role="$SERVICE_ROLE" -f prisma/rls/010_grants.sql
scripts.db:rls: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; psql "${DATABASE_URL%%\?*}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v app_role="$APP_ROLE" -v service_role="$SERVICE_ROLE" -f prisma/rls/policies.sql
scripts.db:bypass: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; psql "${DATABASE_URL%%\?*}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v service_role="$SERVICE_ROLE" -f prisma/rls/020_service_bypass.sql
scripts.db:deploy: prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:grants && npm run db:rls && npm run db:bypass
scripts.db:setup: prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:roles && npm run db:grants && npm run db:rls && npm run db:bypass && npm run db:seed && npm run db:verify
scripts.qa:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run db:verify && npm run qa
